data.name: AboutMission
data.value: Help people study languages with structured courses, practice regularly, and track progress independently.

data.name: AboutProblem
data.value: Lessons, practice, review and progress live in one clear learning experience.

data.name: AboutPhilosophy
data.value: Follow the original Units, practice regularly, check answers after attempting work, and revisit mistakes.

data.name: AboutCapabilities
data.value: Read lessons, submit exercises, review vocabulary, use browser speech, practice with a ChatGPT file, and back up progress.

data.name: AboutLocal
data.value: Progress and notes stay in your browser. You control backup export and import.

data.name: AboutTechnology
data.value: Blazor WebAssembly .NET 10, MudBlazor, static JSON courses and IndexedDB. No application server is required.

data.name: AboutPrinciples
data.value: Preserve source materials, publish only approved resources, describe working capabilities accurately, and never invent learning statistics.

data.name: PrivacyIntro
data.value: You control the learning data stored in your browser and your exported backup files.

data.name: PrivacyStorage
data.value: Progress and notes are stored in browser IndexedDB. The app does not require a backend account.

data.name: PrivacyTransfer
data.value: There is no automatic cross-device sync. Clearing site data can erase progress; export a backup first.

data.name: PrivacyBackup
data.value: Exported JSON files may contain private notes and answers. Keep them somewhere safe.

data.name: PrivacyChat
data.value: Only when you choose to upload a practice file to ChatGPT does that content go to ChatGPT. Its handling follows your applicable ChatGPT settings and policies.
